title: Ensure /tmp is a separate partition
command: findmnt /tmp 2>/dev/null && echo PASS || echo FAIL
remediation: Configure /tmp as a separate partition in /etc/fstab

title: Ensure noexec option on /tmp
command: findmnt -n /tmp | grep -q noexec && echo PASS || echo FAIL
remediation: Add noexec to /tmp mount options in /etc/fstab

title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled
command: grep -i '^PermitRootLogin' /etc/ssh/sshd_config 2>/dev/null | grep -iq 'no' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

title: Ensure SSH protocol 2 is used
command: ssh -V 2>&1 | grep -q 'OpenSSH' && echo PASS || echo FAIL
remediation: Ensure OpenSSH is installed and updated

title: Ensure SSH MaxAuthTries is 4 or less
command: grep -i '^MaxAuthTries' /etc/ssh/sshd_config 2>/dev/null | awk '{if($2<=4) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'

title: Ensure SSH PasswordAuthentication awareness
command: grep -i '^PasswordAuthentication' /etc/ssh/sshd_config 2>/dev/null || echo 'default'
remediation: Consider disabling PasswordAuthentication and using key-based auth

title: Ensure firewall is active (ufw/iptables/firewalld)
command: (ufw status 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'active' || systemctl is-active firewalld 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'active' || iptables -L 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'Chain') && echo PASS || echo FAIL
remediation: Enable and configure a firewall: ufw enable or systemctl start firewalld

title: Ensure default deny firewall policy
command: iptables -L INPUT 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -q 'DROP\|REJECT' && echo PASS || echo CHECK
remediation: Set default firewall policy to DROP: iptables -P INPUT DROP

title: Ensure password expiration is configured
command: grep '^PASS_MAX_DAYS' /etc/login.defs 2>/dev/null | awk '{if($2<=90 && $2>0) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'

title: Ensure minimum password length >= 8
command: grep '^PASS_MIN_LEN' /etc/login.defs 2>/dev/null | awk '{if($2>=8) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'

title: Ensure no accounts have empty passwords
command: awk -F: '($2 == "") {print $1}' /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null | wc -l | awk '{if($1==0) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'
remediation: Set passwords for all accounts or lock them: passwd -l <user>

title: Ensure permissions on /etc/passwd are 644
command: stat -c '%a' /etc/passwd 2>/dev/null | grep -q '644' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

title: Ensure permissions on /etc/shadow are 640 or stricter
command: perm=$(stat -c '%a' /etc/shadow 2>/dev/null); [ "$perm" = '640' ] || [ "$perm" = '600' ] || [ "$perm" = '000' ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL

title: Ensure auditd is installed and running
command: (systemctl is-active auditd 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'active' || systemctl is-active audit 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'active') && echo PASS || echo FAIL
remediation: Install and enable auditd: apt install auditd && systemctl enable --now auditd

title: Ensure syslog service is running
command: (systemctl is-active rsyslog 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'active' || systemctl is-active syslog-ng 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'active' || systemctl is-active systemd-journald 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'active') && echo PASS || echo FAIL

title: Ensure updates are available check
command: (apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null | wc -l || yum check-update 2>/dev/null | wc -l) 2>/dev/null
remediation: Review and apply pending updates: apt upgrade or yum update

title: Ensure automatic updates are configured
command: (dpkg -l unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^ii' || systemctl is-enabled dnf-automatic 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'enabled') && echo PASS || echo CHECK

title: Ensure NTP time synchronization
command: (timedatectl show 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'NTPSynchronized=yes' || ntpstat 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'synchronised') && echo PASS || echo FAIL

title: Ensure core dumps are restricted
command: grep -q 'hard core 0' /etc/security/limits.conf 2>/dev/null && echo PASS || echo FAIL

title: Ensure ASLR is enabled
command: sysctl kernel.randomize_va_space 2>/dev/null | grep -q '= 2' && echo PASS || echo FAIL
